_published_faq.name: How do I add mcp.quiet.ninja to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add mcp.quiet.ninja to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.quiet.ninja/v1/mcp.
